name: Living N5
notes: Giunta Muebles' Living N5, a single show room on the CASA FOA exhibition platform in Córdoba (the article's interior photographs only — no exterior of the pavilion itself exists to check against, since a show-house room has none; this stands for the room as built). A dark timber-clad box under a single-slope wood-lined roof rising toward the back, as the photographed ceiling does; slatted timber screens down the long front with the indoor garden (the article's planted 'living wall') glimpsed through, its green drapes read as the mesh's darker gaps. Solid timber-lined back and ends, on the exhibition hall's paved floor with two potted trees flanking the entry. Guessed entirely: there being no true exterior, the wall thickness, the screen spacing and the room's real plan proportions, taken from the panoramic interior shots' apparent length against the sofa (about 4 m). Refined: the roof is now a true single-pitch shed rather than a flat lid, and the interior shelf band that was poking through the roofline as stripes is removed.
